title: R Data Intelligence Platform — Capstone
objective: Build an end-to-end analytical platform that transforms raw data into validated insights, predictive results and an interactive application.
scenario: Build an end-to-end analytical platform that transforms raw data into validated insights, predictive results and an interactive application. Use synthetic or authorized data and document any external dependencies.
learning_outcomes: Apply the syllabus concepts relevant to r data intelligence platform — capstone.
Deliver a reproducible solution with explicit acceptance criteria.
Explain a failure case, limitations and next steps.

key_features: Import from files, databases and authorized APIs
Validate inputs and repeatable data cleaning
Conduct exploratory, statistical and predictive analysis
Generate visualizations and reproducible Quarto reports
Include reusable functions or an accompanying package
Test critical functions and generated outputs
Manage dependencies and document deployment, provenance, assumptions and limits
curriculum_coverage: Modules 1–21 plus relevant specialist and professional lessons from Modules 22–23. Capstone scope is adapted from Section D.

starter_material.notes: Project scaffolding only; the course platform does not have a secure R runtime. Use local R or an approved isolated environment for execution.
starter_material.sample_prompt: Begin “R Data Intelligence Platform — Capstone” with a small, deterministic and documented dataset.

required_deliverables: Source files with a clear project structure.
Synthetic or properly authorized sample data and data-provenance notes.
Tests or explicit manual verification evidence.
A README with setup, execution mode, dependencies and limitations.
A final summary explaining design decisions and edge cases.
stretch_features: Automate a reproducibility or quality check.
Improve accessibility, observability or performance based on measured evidence.
completion_requirement: Deliver a source repository, setup instructions, validated sample data, report, interactive app, automated tests and final technical report.
grading_method: Draft human-reviewed project rubric. Code is not executed by the current CodeLeaf platform; no project should be marked complete automatically from an unverified code snippet.
